# slide 2 palette-variants
textbox "h2 s1.0"
  ¶ start | "변형과 그라디언트도 참조로 남는다"{heading 27pt b fg}
shape:rect "shape s1.1.0" fill=accent3 line=none
  ¶ center | "base"{body 18pt bg}
shape:rect "shape s1.1.1" fill=accent3 line=none
  ¶ center | "shade 40%"{body 18pt bg}
shape:rect "shape s1.1.2" fill=accent3 line=none
  ¶ center | "tint 40%"{body 18pt fg}
shape:rect "shape s1.1.3" fill=accent3 line=none
  ¶ center | "alpha 0.5"{body 18pt fg}
shape:roundRect "shape s1.2.0" fill=gradient(accent2,accent6) line=none
  ¶ center | "accent2 → accent6"{body 18pt bg}

  ¶ start | "accent4 글자"{body 18pt accent4}

  ¶ start | "accent5 글자"{body 18pt accent5}
